title: Run a versioned held-out evaluator to claims
narrative: Taloneth wires a versioned evaluator that can be marked held-out so self-improvement cannot quietly train on the sole promotion signal. Accepts Anthropic eval guidance and Verification Horizon[^anth-evals-evaluator][^arxiv-verif-horizon].
implementation: `Evaluator`, `CallableEvaluator`, and `evaluate_claims` in `mechaharness.evaluator` compose deterministic claim producers with version and held_out metadata beside VerificationPolicy.
validation: Kind `evaluator_compose_run`. Soft expects passed and held_out true.

footnotes.label: Anthropic Demystifying evals for AI agents
